faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful:
(1)
For any business or security guard to fail immediately to turn over to the city police
                  department or other law enforcement agency any person arrested by such guard pursuant
                  to the laws of the state. Nothing contained in this article shall be construed as
                  authorizing any individual to make an arrest of any person, except as provided by
                  the laws of the state.
(2)
For any business or security guard who discharges a firearm within the city to fail
                  immediately to report such incident to the city police department. Nothing contained
                  in this article shall be construed as authorizing any individual to carry a concealed
                  weapon, except as provided by the laws of the state.
(3)
For any business or security guard, or any contract security agency to hinder or interfere
                  with any investigation under the jurisdiction of the city police department.
(4)
For any business or security guard, or any contract security agency to fail immediately
                  to report to the city police department any city ordinance violation, or to report
                  to the city police department or other appropriate law enforcement agency any violation
                  of state or federal law.
(Code 1981, § 21-93; Ord. No. 3739, § 2, 3-4-2002)
